approximation: Finite samples of the physical demand set; not a six-dimensional volume or a proof of full coverage

sampling_distribution.position: Face probability proportional to physical area; uniform barycentric area within each face
sampling_distribution.direction: Uniform solid angle in the local inward cone; uniform cos(theta) and phi
sampling_distribution.magnitude: Uniform magnitude in [0,K]; not uniform force-vector volume
sampling_distribution.conditioning: Reject occluded tool rays and continue until count reachable demands are collected
sampling_distribution.joint_measure: reachable surface area x solid angle x uniform magnitude

coverage_estimator: sum(satisfied_i)/count, using the same fixed samples for every candidate
